title: Automated phishing analysis
summary: Employees report suspicious emails; an AI pipeline checks every one in seconds.

steps.label: report
steps.title: Someone clicks "Report phishing"
payload: Display name looks right; the domain doesn't.

steps.label: detonate links
steps.title: Check headers and links safely
steps.text: Code checks email authentication results, and links are opened in an isolated sandbox browser, never on a real machine.
payload: The sender isn't who they claim.
lands on a fake login page
copy of the company sign-in page

steps.label: email + evidence
steps.title: The LLM reads it like an analyst would
steps.text: Models are good at spotting manipulation: urgency, threats, mismatched branding. The email body is treated as untrusted data.

steps.label: purge copies
steps.title: Remove it from every inbox
steps.text: The same email usually went to many people. The pipeline finds and pulls every copy and blocks the sender domain.
payload: Their passwords are reset and sessions revoked.

steps.label: thank you
steps.title: Close the loop
steps.text: Telling the reporter what happened encourages more people to report.
